notes.title: Devlog#4: Unveiling The Puzzle System
notes.content:
Devlog Update: Exciting Puzzle System in Paranormal Flipper! ːsteamhappyː

We're excited to share the latest addition to Paranormal Flipper – an engaging puzzle system to deepen your haunted house renovations!

1. Hidden Safes
   - Find and unlock hidden safes with valuable items and clues.

2. Secret Rooms
   - Discover concealed rooms by solving subtle hints.

3. Symbol Matching
   - Align symbols and patterns to reveal hidden mechanisms.

4. Light and Shadow
   - Use light to cast shadows and uncover secret messages.

5. Riddles and Ciphers
   - Solve intellectual puzzles for deeper mysteries.

6. Mechanical Challenges
   - Repair contraptions to unlock doors and hidden areas.

7. We Value Your Feedback
   - Share your thoughts on the new puzzle system to help us improve your experience!

Explore these new features and dive deeper into the eerie world of Paranormal Flipper. More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Devlog#3:The Introduction of Sanity Pills 💊👻
notes.content:
Greetings, fearless renovators! In our spine-tingling update for "Paranormal Flipper," we unveil a new element that's bound to keep you on the edge of your seat (and sanity!) - the introduction of sanity pills. These are not just any renovations; they are battles against the unseen, where not just skills, but mental fortitude will be tested. 🚪🌀 

1. Understanding Sanity

As you peel away decay and confront restless spirits, your grip on reality wavers. Sanity pills become critical, shielding you from the psychological effects of the paranormal as environments grow more sinister.

2. Using Sanity Pills Wisely
Sanity pills are scarce and should be used strategically. Each restores some sanity, allowing you to continue without succumbing to horrors. However, relying too much may lead to shortages when needed most.

3. Managing Your Sanity
Your sanity level affects every action, from renovations to interactions with spirits. Maintaining stability is crucial to avoiding nightmares.

4. Sanity Pills' Hidden Effects
While sanity pills offer relief, they may also reveal unsettling truths. Over-reliance might unlock perceptions best left unseen.

5. Your turn
Tell us about the scariest moments or give us ideas. Let us know how we can further enhance this gripping feature.

Looking forward to your tales of bravery, 

CrossBone ☠️

notes.title: Devlog#2: The Inventory System 🎒👻
notes.content:
We're working at full speed on Paranormal Flipper, and we're excited to announce the addition of the inventory system, a crucial element for the game. Get ready for streamlined organization and expanded equipment options as you prepare to uncover supernatural mysteries!

1. Easy Access Inventory 

Our updated system ensures finding and organizing tools is a breeze, keeping you ready for anything. 

2. Expanded Equipment Selection 

From advanced cameras to specialized tools, we've added everything you need for your paranormal investigations. 

3. Personalized Gear Setup 

Customize your gear to match your preferences, whether it's focused on detection, communication, or exploration. 

4. Enhance Your Skills 

Upgrade your equipment to improve your abilities, giving you an edge when facing supernatural challenges. 

5. Share Your Feedback 

Your input is invaluable. Let us know how we can further enhance your experience in Paranormal Flipper!

notes.title: Devlog#1:New Spooks Incoming! 👻🏚️
notes.content:
Hey there, renovators! Big news: we're adding new ghosts to make your flips spookier. 🚪👻 

1. Meet the Ennemy 

Get ready! We're bringing 3D and 2D ghosts into the game. Each one looks different and has its own creepy backstory. Every haunted house is unique, with its own scary ghost. 🎨👾 

2. Each House Has Its Ghost 

Every flip is now a ghost story. Find out why each house is haunted as you work. It's not just about fixing up; it's about facing fears. 🏠💀 

3. Why It's Cool 

We want each house flip to feel like a new adventure. These ghosts aren't just for scares; they add to the story and challenge of each renovation. Be brave and smart to get through. 🛠️🔦 

4. The Look of Fear 

From shadows to wall crawlers, we designed these ghosts to fit their haunted houses perfectly. The game's getting creepier in the best way. 😨🖼️ 

5. Our Unique Artstyle 

Our game's special art style combines 2D art with realistic scenes for a one of a kind experience. Explore a world where the paranormal meets stunning visuals! 🎨🌟 

6. Your Turn 

Each haunted house and its ghost are waiting for you. Tell us about the scariest moments or give us ideas. We love making this game even better with your help. 📝❤️ 

Gear up for some spooky flips,  

CrossBone☠️
